title: Speculative Decoding Audit Series
description: A public series of reproducible audits on speculative decoding: acceptance floors, compression operators, and measured serving cost. The repository is the display layer; LaTeX source, review harness, and submission workflow are private. Code is Apache-2.0; docs and draft PDFs are CC-BY-4.0.
